correctness.rationale: The frozen hypotheses in RESULT.md line 29 literally permit at most one nonzero coefficient. Under that restriction |g|² is constant, the claimed supremum is R/r rather than (R/r)³, and Γ₂(δ) is 2δ rather than 2((1+δ)³−1). This contradicts both the Finding and the two-active-frequency witness. For the evident intended at-most-two-tone class the proof is sound: centered parity diagonalizes the two energies, and division by the radius cubed reduces to decreasing F±(z)=(z±sin z)/z³. On (0,π] the plus derivative is directly negative and the minus derivative is negative by the displayed half-angle identity; for z≥π both derivative numerators are bounded above by 3−z<0. The verified collision limit is the energy ratio of t−c, giving (R/r)³, unattained for positive gaps, with the shell normalization obtained by subtracting the inner integral and multiplying by two. Inspected VERIFICATION.md and verify_energy.py without executing the uploaded script.
